summary: Forest Lookouts and tnlandforms list a 'douglas' tower in Coffee County, a 94-foot oil derrick fire tower the City of Douglas sold at auction in 2011 and resold in 2012.

facts.design: Oil Derrick fire tower, 94 feet tall (per the Forest Lookouts page)
facts.status_note: Sold at auction in 2011 and resold in 2012; no source says whether anything stands at the site.

events.note: City of Douglas sold the 94-foot Oil Derrick fire tower at auction for $4,010

notes_for_editor: Both sources give only a name and county for this tower. The Forest Lookouts entry has no coordinates, so the tie to this record rests on the name 'douglas' and Coffee County, backed by the list's 'no cab' entry at the same name and county. Height converted from 94 feet (94 x 0.3048 = 28.65 m, shown as 28.7). No build date, builder or staffing found. Story is about 150 words. Not on the NHLR Georgia list or the FFLOS Georgia listing checked. The record's registers carry 'US' prefixes that the list does not use.
